note: Placeholder programmer art for organic growth over the pipe growth / subway / driller / doomsday door / machine boss levels, drawn by tools/blocks_themed.py; shapes follow scene mockups that are not in the repository.

flesh-wall.note: wet flesh mass: burgundy and pink folds, dark crevices and pores, wet highlights

tendrils-on-panel.note: steel wall panel with dark red tendrils crawling across it

tendrils-hanging.note: flesh mass along the top edge with strands hanging down, thinning, drips at their ends

egg-sacs.note: cluster of glowing green-yellow translucent egg sacs with embryos in flesh webbing

pod-cluster.note: purple-grey glossy pods in flesh webbing, green drips

slime-drip.note: green slime band along the top with drips running down over a dark panel

acid-pool.note: green toxic liquid from row 22 down: bright surface line, ripples, bubbles, glow above

acid-fall.note: vertical green toxic stream (columns 16-47) with bright streaks and spray on a dark wall

flesh-pipe.note: horizontal steel pipe (rows 20-43, as pipe-h) wrapped in flesh cuffs and tendrils, strands hanging

honeycomb.note: flesh honeycomb membrane: rounded cells with dark holes and pink rims, 16 px grid

bone-ribs.note: spine of pale vertebrae along the top with curved ribs every 16 px over dark flesh

glow-fungus.note: pale shelf fungus caps with pink-lit gills and glow, on a concrete pillar edge at the left

rock-wall.note: cave rock: angular cells in browns with dark cracks and lit edges

stalactite.note: rock ceiling along the top with hanging stalactites and drips

spore-growth.note: rock with pale green spore crystals and spore dust

eye-pustule.note: large glowing orange eye with a slit pupil in a swollen flesh socket

flesh-floor.note: concrete floor slab with a flesh crust on top and tendrils draping over its front face

tendril-column.note: concrete pillar wrapped by diagonal sinews, a thick trunk on the left and a strand on the right
